contexts.text: The rib... He builded into a woman ()... A woman = what is man's Own vivified by the Lord. He brought her to the man = that what is his Own was granted him. For the posterity of this Church... did not want to be... a celestial man, but wanted to lead themselves... and therefore what was their Own was granted them, but vivified by the Lord, and therefore it is called woman, and afterwards wife. AC 154:2. AC 155. (It is called wife in no. AC 156, although it is the same word in the Hebrew.)

That what is man's Own is signified by the woman, may be known from the fact that it was the woman who was beguiled; for nothing ever beguiles man but what is his Own; or, what is the same, the love of self and the world.
It is said that the rib was built into a woman, and not that the woman was created, or formed, or made... because building = raising up that which is fallen.

Jehovah hath created a new thing in the earth - a woman shall compass a man (). This signifies the heavenly marriage, and by the woman is signified what is man's Own vivified by the Lord... for this is of such a nature that it encompasses, as a rib made flesh encompasses the heart.
The love of self, or man's Own love, is represented (in ) by the woman.
The serpent... said to the woman () = (to) what is man's Own. AC 205.

The woman saw that the tree was good for food... and she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and she gave also unto her man with her, and he did eat ()... This was the fourth posterity of the Most Ancient Church, who suffered themselves to be seduced by their Own love, and were not willing to believe things revealed, unless they saw them confirmed by things of sense and memory-knowledge.

The woman whom Thou gavest to be with me she gave me of the tree, and I did eat. And Jehovah God said unto the woman. Wherefore hast thou done this? And the woman said. The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat () = that the Rational of the man suffered itself to be deceived by what was his Own, which was dear to him, that is, by the love of self, so that he believed nothing unless he saw and felt it.

I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed ()... The serpent, here, = all evil in general; in special, the love of self; the woman = the Church... and the seed of the woman = faith in the Lord. AC 255. Explained.
That the woman = the Church. Explained.
The Church is called woman from its heavenly and angelic proprium (that is, from what is its Own made heavenly and angelic). Illustrated.

The Lord Himself also is called the seed of the woman, both because He alone gives faith, and thus is faith, and because it pleased Him to be born, and that in such a Church as had fallen entirely into an infernal and diabolical proprium... in order that of His Divine power He might unite, in His human essence, the Divine celestial proprium to the human proprium, so that they should become one in Him... As the Lord is thus the seed of the woman, it is not called it, but he.

And unto the woman He said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow, and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth sons, and thine obedience shall be to thy man, and he shall rule over thee (). The woman now = the Church, from what was its Own, which it loved... Sorrow = combat, and anxiety... Conception = all thought. Sons brought forth in sorrow = truths... The man = the Rational, that... would rule over the Church.
The woman, here, = the Church perverted by what was its Own, because it is treating of the posterity of the Most Ancient Church.
Immodest women in Gehenna. Described.
How the antediluvian women were dressed.
I might have taken her to mo for a woman () = that so the truth... might have had violence done to it.
(He brought back) the women and the people () = both the goods and the truths.

She gave her to Abram... for a woman () = conjunction through the incitement of the affection of truth... Hagar was not given for a wife, but for a woman, because... it is not a marriage unless it be of one man with one wife...
It had ceased to be with Sarah... as with women () = that (the Human with the Lord) could no longer remain so.
Old women = goods confirmed.
Thou wilt die because of the woman () = that the doctrine of faith would be null if the Rational were consulted... Sister, here called woman, = the Rational.
The woman who fled into the wilderness () = the temptation of the Church.

Thou shalt not take a woman for my son of the daughters of the Canaanite () = that the Divine Rational was not to be conjoined with any affection that was in disagreement with truth. To take a woman = to be conjoined by a covenant of marriage... By the woman who was to be associated by a covenant of marriage, is meant the Divine truth itself, which was to be called forth from the natural man by the common way.

Perhaps the woman is not willing to go after me to this land () = a doubting of the natural man respecting that affection as to whether it was separable; for the woman = truth which was to be conjoined with the Divine good of the Rational; and, as all conjunction is effected by means of affection, by the woman is signified the affection of that truth.

He took Rebekah, and she was to him for a woman ., () = the conjunction of good and truth... The reason she was said to be for a woman, and not for a wife, is that between rational good and the truth called forth from the Natural and made Divine, there is not a marriage, but a covenant which resembles the marriage covenant.
Abraham's woman (Keturah) = the Lord as to the Divine truth adjoined to Divine spiritual good.
Truth is what the wife represents because it is in the second place, and therefore, in the Word... the Church is called a woman, etc.
The women who had Known a man () = affections of what is false.
The woman encompassed with the sun... () = the Church... AC 4918:3. AC 7293:end. AC 10249:7. DFaith 59.
One of the people might lightly have lain with thy woman () = that (Divine truth) might have been adulterated... Woman (here, Rebekah) = Divine truth. AC 3399, Explained.

He that toucheth this man and his woman, dying he shall die () = that Divine truth and Divine good are not to be opened... on account of the eternal damnation if they should be profaned... Truth is here mentioned in the first place, and good in the second, because the Spiritual Church is treated of...
He took as a woman Judith... () = the adjunction of natural truth from another source... for a woman = truth adjoined to good; here, natural truth adjoined to natural good.
Thou shalt not take a woman of the daughters of Canaan () = provided it be not conjoined with affections of falsity and evil.
To take him from thence a woman () = conjunction through the affection of truth; for a woman = the affection of truth.
She gave him Bilhah... for a woman () = the affirmative medium adjoined... for to give for a woman = to adjoin.
The woman (of the Hebrew servant) = the affection of natural good.
The separation of the good and truth represented by Jacob and his women from the good signified by Laban. Treated of.
Give her to him for a woman () = a longing for conjunction with this new Church... AC 4457.
A woman appeared (at a bath) who soon vanished into a blackish cloud... She = such female insidiators. Described. AC 4627:3.

I saw a woman who stretched out her hand, wishing to stroke the cheek (of Aristotle), and he said that when he was in the world such a woman was often seen by him, who as it were stroked his cheek, and that her hand was beautiful. The angelic Spirits said that such women were sometimes seen by the ancients, and were called by them Pallases; and that she appeared to him from those Spirits who, when they lived as men in ancient times, were delighted with ideas, and indulged in cogitations, but without philosophy; and because such Spirits were with him... they presented such a woman representatively. SE 3952.
For, in the Word, a man = falsity; and his woman, evil.

(Carriages) for your infants and for your women () = for those who do not as yet know the interior things of the Church... For women = the affections of truth; for when men = truths, their women = the affections of truth; and, conversely, when men = goods, their women = truths; but in this case the men are called husbands. The affections of truth... do not know the interior things of the Church, except through the truths, called the men. Without these, the affections are like the will without the Intellectual...
(The sons of Israel carried) their women () = the things of charity; for women = goods when their men = truths. AC 8337.
Two women () which are Jerusalem and Samaria = the Church.
The Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women () = that the scientifics of the Church are not such as the scientifics which are contrary to them... For women = the things of the Church.
The woman conceived () = the first of the birth of the Divine law... The woman, here = the same as the daughter of Levi whom the man of the house of Levi married, namely, truth conjoined with good.
A woman a nurse from the Hebrew women () = the insinuation of good from the Church itself.
The woman took the child, and suckled him () = that good from the Church was insinuated into it. The woman = the Church.

Every woman shall ask of her neighbour... () = that the good of everyone will be enriched... For a woman = the affection of the good of charity... The reason a woman was to ask, is that by a woman is signified the good of charity, and this is what is to be enriched; for good, in order to be good, must have truths which qualify it. Explained.
Like two beautiful women, one putrescent within from scortation, and the other pure within from chastity, or genuine conjugial love. AC 8452:end.
When the Spiritual Church is treated of, women represent good, and men truth; but when the Celestial Church is treated of, women represent truth, and men good.
All the women went forth after her () = all the goods of truth; for women = affections of good when men = affections of truth.
A woman an adulteress () meaning the house of Israel, = the Church there...
This is a woman... and he said, This is evil (); a woman = evil, as is openly stated.
Two women lifting up the ephah between the earth and the heaven () = the Churches by which what is profane was banished.
Thy sword hath bereaved women () = that their falsity inflicts violence on good affections.
That women = affections. References.
Come not near a woman () = the purification of the good of faith; for the marriages among the Israelitish nation were impure... hence not to come near a woman = to abstain from what is impure.
For the woman of the Hebrew servant = delight (not good) conjoined with truth Explained.

But good from a spiritual origin is meant by the woman whom the master gives to his servant; but as this cannot be conjoined it was ordered that when the servant went out, the woman should be the master's, and also her sons and daughters. Explained. AC 8979. AC 8980. AC 8981. AC 8982. AC 8983.
Shall strike a pregnant woman () = injury of the good that is from truth... (Thus) a pregnant woman = the state of the formation of good from truths.
The woman = good.
When an ox shall gore a man or a woman () = if the affection of evil in the Natural shall injure the truth or the good of faith. AC 9073.
He shall endow her to himself for a woman () = a pledge of consent to a lawful conjunction.
Your women shall become widows () = that the goods with them will perish... The reason women = goods, is that by the marriage of a man and a woman is represented the conjunction of truth and good.
The woman of Sidon () = the Church that is in the Knowledges of truth and good.
Women () = evils of the Church.

The woman is born to be voluntary, thus to think from the will, as is evident from her inclination or connate nature, and also from her form; (for) a woman acts from affection... and has a smoother and more beautiful face, a higher voice, and a more tender body... Hence, in the Word, a virgin, and a woman = the affection of good; and the Church is called a woman and a virgin from the affection of good and of truth.
A woman enjoys both understanding and will, but still in her the will predominates, and a human being is according to that which predominates.

(These most wicked of the Papists) are described by the woman sitting on the scarlet beast (). A woman = the Church; here, in the opposite sense, a profane religiosity. AR 723. AR 737. AR 751. AE 1038. SE 5858.
(The locusts) had hair as the hair of women () = that they appeared to themselves as if they were in the affection of truth. AR 434.
The man is born understanding, and the woman affection.
That woman = the affection of truth. Illustrated.
Hence it is that the Church is called wife, woman, etc. Illustrated.

A woman encompassed with the sun, and the moon under her feet () = the Lord's New Church in the Heavens, which is the New Heaven; and the Lord's New Church that will be on earth, which is the New Jerusalem. Explained. ( = the Church with those who are in love to the Lord, and thence in love towards the neighbour, and also faith in those who are natural, and who are in charity. For a woman = the spiritual affection of truth. AE 707. AE 708, Explained.) ( = the faith of the New Church. BE 103.) SE 6070.

And she, having in the womb, cried, and was tormented to bear () = the nascent doctrine of the New Church, and its difficult reception on account of the resistance made by those who are meant by the dragon. AE 710.

And the dragon stood before the woman who was ready to bear, that, when she had borne, he might devour her child () = that those meant by the dragon busy themselves in extinguishing the doctrine of the New Church in its first rise. ( = the hatred of those who are meant by the dragon against the Church with those who will be in the doctrine and derivative life of love and charity from the Lord. AE 721.)

The woman fled into the wilderness () = the Church, which is the New Jerusalem, at first among a few. By the woman is signified a New Church. ( = the Church among a few, because with those who are not in good, and therefore neither in truths. AE 730, Explained. AE 731, Explained.)

The dragon... persecuted the woman who brought forth the son () = that the dragonists in the World of Spirits, after being cast down, immediately began to infest the New Church on account of ts doctrine. ( = that those meant by the dragon, would, from hatred and enmity, reject and calumniate the Church which is the New Jerusalem, because it has the doctrine of life. AE 758.)

And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place () = the Divine circumspection for that Church, and protection while it is still among a few. By the woman is signified a New Church. ( = the spiritual intelligence and circumspection which the Lord gives those who are of that Church. The woman = the Church that is called the New Jerusalem, consequently the men of that Church. AE 759.)

Where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent () = that on account of the cunning of those who seduce, it is provided with circumspection that the New Church may come among more, until it grows to its appointed state. ( = until the Church grows, and comes to its fulness. AE 761.)
And the serpent cast out after the woman... water as a flood, that he might cause her to be swallowed up... () = reasonings from falsities in abundance to destroy the Church. AE 763, Explained.

And the earth helped the woman; and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed up the flood... () = that (these) reasonings fall to nothing from the spiritual truths rationally understood, which the Michaels, of whom the New Church consists, advance. By the earth that helped the woman is signified the Church as to doctrine... and it is truths from the Word, by which the earth = that is, the Church = helps the woman; and by opening its mouth is signified to adduce these truths. ( = that those who are of a Church that is not in truths afforded assistance, and did not receive the cunning reasonings... Explained. AE 764.)

And the dragon was angry against the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, who keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ () = the hatred kindled with those who believe themselves wise from their confirmations of the mystical union of the Divine and the Human in the Lord, and of justification by faith alone, against those who acknowledge the Lord alone as the God of Heaven and earth, and that the decalogue is the law of life, [shown by] their assailing novitiates with the design of seducing them. ( = the hatred of those who are meant by the dragon, against the Church which is the New Jerusalem, and which is kindled by their perceiving that it is favoured by many. AE 767.)

These are they who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins () = that they have not adulterated the truths of the Church, and defiled them with falsities of faith; but have loved truths because they are truths. A woman = the Church, from the affection of truth; and consequently, in the opposite sense, the Church from the affection of what is false. AE 862.
In the middle (of the place of worship of the solifidians was seen) the image of a woman, clad in a scarlet garment, holding a golden coin in her right hand, and a chain of pearls in her left.
(Women mentioned as being seen in the Spiritual World.) CL 75:4.
a. [end]. For women have an interior perception of love; and men only an exterior one.
Who does not then regard other women with a look of indifference -nutu inanimato?

I asked. Such being the union, can you look at any other woman than your own? He replied, I can; but as my wife is united to my soul, we both look together, and then nothing of lust can enter. Explained.

It is believed by many that women can perform the offices of men, provided they are initiated into them from their earliest age... They can indeed be initiated into the exercise of these things, but not into the judgment on which the rightness of the offices interiorly depends; and therefore those women who have been initiated into the offices of men, are obliged to consult men in matters of judgment; and then, if they are at their own disposal, they choose from their counsels what favours their own love.

It is also supposed by some that women are equally able to elevate the sight of their understanding into the same sphere of light as men, and that they can discern matters in the same height, which opinion has been induced by the writings of certain learned authoresses. But these writings, when examined in the Spiritual World in their presence, were found to be works, not of judgment and wisdom, but of cleverness and eloquence; and works that proceed from these two, from the elegance and neatness of their style, appear to be sublime and erudite; but only to those who call all ingenuity wisdom.
See Man.
The prudence in thus acting has been implanted in women from creation...
In the first beginnings of marriage we were married-women; but now we are wives.
Husbands grow cold towards their wives while they regard strange women with concupiscence.
Under Wife, see this reference. CL 294:5.
Seven women seen sitting on a bed of roses...
Whether any woman who is constantly loving her own beauty can love her man. Explained.
That after death the love of infants remains, especially with women. Explained.
That the Lord put off the human from the mother... may be seen from the fact that He called Mary... woman. Illustrated.
(In that cavern) each is allowed to take one (of the harlots) and to call her his woman.
This (penalty) is more applicable to women = in whom cupidities are wont to have predominance who meddle in things which regard the doctrines of faith, like men.
The greatest part of these (babbling) Spirits are women.
When it was said that (the Lord) was not of the seed of the man, but of the seed of the woman... they acknowledged.
The women (of the antediluvians) were small.
A woman was seen by them who was clad in a short cloak... and whose face was withdrawn within the cloak. Explained.
A woman was seen dressed like a man...
There appeared on the shoulders of a woman known to me in her bodily life (Maria Polhem) a little dog. (See Dog.)
The woman who uttered the prayer... with such sanctity... was evil... and wanted to kill me magically...
There came a certain woman, who had some of the flesh of a leg wrapped in a cloth... which she gave (the cerberus) to eat. SE 4947-4951, Explained.
The Dutch women there are separated from their men, and dwell at one side of the city... which is because domineering is implanted in them. (See Dutch, at LJCont 51:2.)
On old women who are in hospitals. General article.
As the woman has been born affection of truth and good...
The idea of God as a Man exists... with women...
A woman with me who... believed that it is impossible to love one's consort long... SE 6110:8.
With women the nerves are softer and the veins wider; the thighs are broader because they = conjugial love.
With (such) the woman's love is not communicated to the man...
But when the woman's affection inflows into the man's understanding, as is the case with the Angels, whence they have intelligence in their life (the conjugial love is permanent).
Jesus... saith unto His mother. Woman, behold thy son (). Mother, and woman, here, = the Church. AE 250:8. AE 785:5.
Women, in the Word, = the goods that are of the Church.
A woman beloved of her companion, and an adulteress () = such a Church.
Besides women and children () = those who are in goods.
A woman of Samaria () = a Church made up of such.
That woman = the Church as to the affection of truth. Illustrated.

As woman = the Church as to the affection of truth from good, that is, the affection of truth from good possessed by the man of the Church, in the opposite sense, women = the cupidity of falsity from evil. Illustrated.
Woman, in the Word, = the Church. Illustrated.
Man and woman () = truth conjoined with good, and the derivative intelligence.
The reason a woman is said to have lost a piece of silver () is that a woman = the Church as to the affection of truth, and therefore also the affection of truth that is of the Church.
Ten women shall bake bread in one oven () = that in all the things of the Church with man there is so little of good and truth as to be scarcely any; ten women = all things of the Church.

Woman is born to act from affection... and the affection with women is the affection of truth and good... and in Heaven the correspondent affection which belongs to the woman is conjoined with the correspondent understanding which belongs to the man.
The woman treated of in  is the one who is called the Bride, the Lamb's wife, which was the holy city Jerusalem coming down out of Heaven from God ().
The women etc. of the nations were not smitten () because they signified evils, and evils can be subdued, amended, and reformed by means of truths.
The affection of the natural man, persuaded by its Sensuous... is signified by the woman... taking of the fruit of the tree (). Coro 31.
By the woman (in ) the Papists understand Mary...
A woman of whoredoms (whom Hosea was commanded to take, ) = the Church that was falsifying the truths of the Word.
Women () = goods conjoined with truths.
I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast () = the dominion of the papal religiosity over the holy things of the Word. AE 1042. AE 1062.
